rules.keys: HTTP: "METHOD /path"; Dhru: "DHRU <action>"; supplier calls: "SUPPLIER <action>[+<bulk action>]"; outgoing events: "EVENT <name>"
rules.crud: L=GET /resource, S=GET /resource/:id, C=POST /resource, U=PATCH /resource/:id, D=DELETE /resource/:id; other rows are one endpoint
rules.access: normalised from the map auth text per surface (scripts/lib/map.mjs); admin "x:y" = staff permission, v1 "x:y" = API key scope
rules.modules: every row belongs to exactly one module (scripts/module-map.mjs); table ownership follows the map domains
rules.frontend: admin endpoints point at the frontend function carrying the same @route tag (FRONTEND_DIR)

endpoints.description: Overall status (Operational, Degraded or Outage), the running build (version, commit, environment), the status of each component, uptime over 24 hours, 7 and 30 days, open alerts, ongoing incidents and the maintenance state.

endpoints.description: API performance per surface over a time range: requests/min, latency p50, p95 and p99, 4xx and 5xx rates, 429 count and the 10 slowest endpoints. Read from the monitoring system.

endpoints.descriptionAr: أكثر الأخطاء تكراراً حسب code والـ endpoint بمدى زمني، مع أول وآخر ظهور وrequest_id ورابط Sentry
endpoints.description: Most frequent errors by code and endpoint over a time range, with first and last seen, request_id and a Sentry link.

endpoints.descriptionAr: صحة خط الطلبات: العالق أكثر من SLA لكل حالة، وزمن الإرسال p95، ونسبة النجاح والفشل لكل نوع خدمة، والموقوف عند المخاطر
endpoints.description: Order pipeline health: orders stuck beyond SLA per status, dispatch time p95, success and failure rate per service type, and orders held by risk.

endpoints.descriptionAr: صحة كل مورد: يعمل أو متوقف، آخر نداء ناجح، زمن الاستجابة، نسبة الخطأ والـ timeout، حالة circuit breaker، آخر مزامنة، ورصيدنا عنده. الإيقاف المؤقت بـ PATCH /admin/suppliers/:id (status = paused)
endpoints.description: Health of each supplier: up or down, last successful call, response time, error and timeout rate, circuit-breaker state, last sync and our balance with them. Pausing uses PATCH /admin/suppliers/:id (status = paused).

endpoints.description: Postgres: connections out of the maximum and pool wait, slowest queries (pg_stat_statements), locks and long transactions, replica lag, size and growth, and pending migrations.

endpoints.descriptionAr: فحوص سلامة المال: مجموع كل قيد صفر، ورصيد كل حساب يساوي مجموع أسطره، وحجوزات عالقة أكثر من 24 ساعة، ودفعات مؤكدة بلا قيد، وآخر نتيجة
endpoints.description: Money integrity checks: every entry sums to zero, every account balance equals the sum of its lines, holds stuck over 24 hours, confirmed payments without an entry, and the last result.
